Measurement framework

From activity to outcome.

TIJCEF uses a proportionate results chain for each project. Indicators and tools are agreed before delivery, then reviewed with partners and programme teams.

  1. 1. Inputs

    People, partner contributions, materials and approved budgets.

  2. 2. Activities

    Sessions, outreach, training, service days and research tasks delivered.

  3. 3. Outputs

    Attendance, completion, materials distributed and evidence produced.

  4. 4. Outcomes

    Changes in knowledge, confidence, practice or community capacity measured where feasible.

Measure

Use attendance, activity and feedback records suited to each programme.

Learn

Review what worked, what changed and what should improve before the next cycle.

Protect

Report responsibly without exposing children, vulnerable people or sensitive locations.
